title: pm-dispatch: an unruled decision behind Blocked-by refuses the dispatch; measure-then-decide sends a reading-only dev
body:
Fixes #23379
Clause-②: no

Text-only charter change on three protocol faces, under the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-10-14) on the director seat's proposal, quoted from the card verbatim: 「先裁再派。派发门加一条:卡上有未裁的 `Blocked-by: 决策` 或派发令写「先测量再决定」的,只派「只读读数」的 dev(不建闭包、不跑测试),或根本不派、等裁。」 and 「立卡你决定,不需要我同意」. Second leg of the serial relay behind #23378 (its draft PR #23405 at head `63496bd46c` edits `os-dev.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md` and `AGENTS.md`); this PR is based on `origin/main` `5656c5638a`, not on that branch, and touches none of its hunks (proof below). Draft; the landing tier is whatever `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N` reads for `.claude/**`.

## What changes (text only), before / after

### 1. Dispatch gate — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, 状态模型 table, the `pm:blocked` row (L108), amended in place

Before (159 bytes):

```text
| `pm:blocked` + 正文行 `Blocked-by: #N` | 等上游:选择期跳过,#N 关闭时由解锁扫描放回;工已完、PR 被外部门禁卡住的同用本态 |
```

After (295 bytes; the file's widest-row pin is 342, so the row stays inside it, and a table row is structurally exempt from the 120-byte line cap):

```text
| `pm:blocked` + 正文行 `Blocked-by: #N` | 等上游:选择期跳过,#N 关闭时由解锁扫描放回;工已完、PR 被外部门禁卡住的同用本态;正文或线程行首 `Blocked-by:` 指向无 `Ruled:` 的 open `needs-user-decision` 卡 ⇒ ⛔ 不派发,挂本态直至其 `Ruled:` |
```

The gate sentence: a line-head `Blocked-by:` in the card's body or thread that names an open `needs-user-decision` card carrying no `Ruled:` means the card is not dispatched and hangs `pm:blocked` until that card carries `Ruled:`. It sits where `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` semantics already live (the selection skip, the unlock scan), beside the `needs-user-decision` row (L106, 永不派发) and the red line at L29. `Ruled:` is the marker `references/lanes/director.md` L12 writes on the decision card's first body line when a ruling is recorded.

### 2. Reading-only dev — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, 〈派发词构造细则〉

Before (L235, 112 bytes):

```text
- 测量先行卡(修复由测量结果有条件授权)⇒ 派发令写明 ⛔ 测量存在之前不写修复。
```

After (L235 amended in place, 118 bytes; L236 new, 108 bytes):

```text
- 测量先行卡(修复由测量结果有条件授权)⇒ 只派只读读数 dev 或不派等裁;建设 dev 待裁。
- 只读读数 dev 不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR;只读树与记录,读数贴决策卡或立卡。
```

A measure-first card (a dispatch whose first act is "measure, then decide") dispatches a 只读读数 (reading-only) dev — no worktree closure, no build, no test run, no PR; it reads the tree and the record and posts the reading on the decision card or files one — or is not dispatched at all and waits for the ruling; the building dev follows the ruling. The old clause 「⛔ 测量存在之前不写修复」 is subsumed: a dev that opens no PR writes no fix.

Paid by one deletion in the same file. Deleted L206 (87 bytes):

```text
- 内部 PM 副本 = `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 升级与决策 节的四轴框架块。
```

It restates `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L355 「框架唯一副本在 pm-dispatch SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉;派发词逐字粘贴,dev ⛔ 不留副本。」, and the one fact it carried for the PM side (where the block lives) is folded into its neighbour L205, amended in place: 「四轴框架整段现取现粘、逐单随派发词下发。」 becomes 「四轴框架块(SKILL.md 升级与决策 节)整段现取现粘、逐单随派发词下发。」 (95 bytes).

### 3. The mode's one line — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, 〈何时停手不写码〉 and the report template

New L354 (116 bytes), the sibling of the `needs_decision` line:

```text
- 派发词标只读读数 ⇒ 不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR;报 `status: "reading"`,读数贴决策卡。
```

Report template enum (L364), amended in place:

```text
  "status": "done | rework | blocked | needs_decision",
```

becomes

```text
  "status": "done | rework | blocked | needs_decision | reading",
```

Paid by one deletion in the same file. Deleted old L354 (84 bytes):

```text
- 升级分析的四轴决策框架由派发词携带,PM 从自己那份副本填入。
```

It restates its two siblings: L355 「…派发词逐字粘贴,dev ⛔ 不留副本。」 (the frame arrives via the dispatch order, from the single copy) and L356 「…派发词没带,停下向 PM 索取…」, and `dispatch-runbook.md` L205 「…逐单随派发词下发」 carries the PM side.

## Line budget (ceilings on `main`: 319 / 241 / 402 — every added line paid in the same file, no ceiling moved)

| file | before | after | lines added | lines deleted (named above) | lines amended in place |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 | 319 | 0 | none | L108 row (159 → 295 B) |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 241 | 241 | 1 (L236, 108 B) | L206 (frame-copy pointer) | L205 (95 B), L235 (118 B) |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 402 | 402 | 1 (L354, 116 B) | old L354 (frame carried by the dispatch order) | L364 enum (65 B) |

Every added or amended non-table line is at or under 120 bytes (measured with `Buffer.byteLength`): 116, 65, 95, 118, 108; the SKILL.md row is a table row (exempt class `table` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`) at 295 B against the file's row pin of 342 B. No re-wrap funds any line. No issue number enters a skill file; no model identifier enters any file. The maintainer's term 「只读读数」 is the one spelling in all three files; "reading-only" is its English face here.

## Dry run — the new sentences applied to #23267's claim as it stood at comment 6156257682 (2026-10-13T22:09Z, posted 22:10:28Z)

What the record shows for the card at that instant:

- Label state: `pm:queue` (it had carried `pm:blocked` from 14:09:08Z and moved to `pm:queue` at 20:58:57Z, the unlock scan firing after its `Blocked-by:` target reached the closed state at 20:02:28Z). The claim's own act moved it to `pm:dispatched` at 22:10:22Z.
- Its only line-head `Blocked-by:` is `Blocked-by: #23224` (body line 10 today, line 18 before the `Ruled:` first line and its blank were prepended on 2026-10-14). #23224 is a `domain:engine` enhancement card that never carried `needs-user-decision` (its label timeline has zero such events) and was already in the closed state at 22:09Z.
- #23266 is named only in a prose heading, 「## Why `Blocked-by: #23266`」, not as a line-head marker; `references/state-machine.md` L24 makes the line-head form canonical and a sentence mention prose. And #23266 was no longer an unruled decision at 22:09Z: its ruling (letter C, 「同意」) is comment 6148183570 at 14:44:15Z and `needs-user-decision` left it at 14:44:56Z — 7.4 hours before the claim, which itself says "under ruling C on #23266". At 22:09Z #23266 was a `pm:dispatched` execution card of that ruling (its body carries no `Ruled:` first line; the ruling lives in its comment, which predates the first-line convention).

So the **`Blocked-by:` leg does not refuse** the building dispatch as of 22:09Z: neither card the body names was an open `needs-user-decision` card without `Ruled:`. It would have refused only a dispatch read before 14:44Z.

The **measure-then-decide leg does refuse** it. The claim's File surface reads "the dev measures which door is the record's and declares it in the report and PR body … whichever the measurement shows ADR-0138 D3 item 5 names as the administrator's path", so the dispatch's first act was a measurement whose result selected the route, and the card's own body lists the dev's options as (A) a new door, (B) a new spec key, (C) amend the record — a decision shape. Under runbook L235–236 as amended, that dispatch sends a 只读读数 dev (or nobody, waiting for the ruling): the reading goes on the decision card, no closure is built, no suite runs, no PR opens. What happened instead is the card's own measurement: a building dev built the plugin-security closure under the verify lock and ran two pin suites, returned `status: needs_decision` at 22:28:30Z (comment 6156571003), the card entered `needs-user-decision` at 22:31:36Z, the ruling landed at 02:06:29Z (comment 6159279205, `Ruled:` first line written on the body), and the building dev was dispatched at 02:11Z.

Acceptance item read against the record: one of the two legs refuses (measure-then-decide), the other does not fire at 22:09Z; the card's premise that the `Blocked-by:` leg would have caught this claim is corrected here rather than forced.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not cards)

- #23266's ruling is recorded as a comment (6148183570) and its body carries no `Ruled:` first line; the first-line convention (`lanes/director.md` L12) post-dates it. The gate reads `Ruled:` on the decision card; a reader applying it to pre-convention cards should also accept a `## Ruling` comment as the record. Not filed: no live card is affected (that card is in the closed state), and the convention is already the rule.
- The card's text names "the dispatch reference" for the gate; the dispatch narrowed the file surface to the three files above, so `references/execution-duties.md` L10 (候选 = …无 `needs-user-decision`…) is unchanged — its filter still reads only the card's own labels; the `Blocked-by:`-against-the-decision-box reading lives in the SKILL.md row, which every seat reads.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:三份协议文本各加一句,行数不变(319/241/402)。状态模型表的 `pm:blocked` 行多一条:卡上行首 `Blocked-by:` 指向一张还没 `Ruled:` 的 open 决策卡,就不派发,挂 `pm:blocked` 等裁。派发细则里「测量先行卡」改为只派「只读读数」dev(不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR,读数贴决策卡或立卡)或干脆不派等裁,建设 dev 待裁后再派。os-dev 契约加一行只读读数模式(报 `status: "reading"`),报告枚举多一个 `reading`。新增的行以删掉两句重复表述支付。
- **为什么改**:你 2026-10-14 「同意」的「先裁再派」。#23267 那种卡决策没裁就派了建设 dev,结果是一次 271 秒的闭包构建、两套 pin 测试和一份八千字的 needs_decision 报告,零代码。门加在派发前:读数由便宜的只读 dev 产出,建设在裁决之后。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本,不碰脚本、门禁与 workflow;唯一风险是口径 —— 只认行首 `Blocked-by:` 与决策卡上的 `Ruled:` 标记,散文里提到决策卡不触发,这是既有正典标记规则的延续。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,无数据与状态迁移。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:落地档位由 `check-governed-merges --pr` 读(`.claude/**` 按登记是 Tier S,席位按契约复核落地);若它读为 Tier H,需要你的一次批准。PR 保持 draft。
